name: Culture Intelligence for Workable
description: WhatsApp, LinkedIn Connect, InMail, and direct message outreach buttons with Culture Index status badge for Workable.

content_scripts._note: DO NOT DELETE — InMail only. Unipile does not support InMail (flags/bans account). InMail is sent by driving the LinkedIn ATS widget iframe embedded in Workable. frame-reader.js runs inside that iframe to extract the LinkedIn URL and fill/submit the InMail compose form.
Fetches the numeric LinkedIn member ID (plainId) from /voyager/api/me and caches it in chrome.storage.local so the background service worker can include it in cookie snapshots sent to Unipile.
